description: How often metro trains run on each line through the day (minutes between trains, peak and off-peak) and its operating hours, for a day of the week. Covers the Taipei Wenhu line (文湖線), which has no timetable. Example: system "TRTC", line "BR".

date.description: Day in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD, for its day of the week (default: today).

line.description: Only this line ID, e.g. "BR" (文湖線), "R", "BL" (default: every line).

system.description: Metro system: TRTC 臺北捷運 Taipei Metro, NTMC 新北捷運 (環狀線) New Taipei Metro, TYMC 桃園機場捷運 Taoyuan Airport MRT, TMRT 臺中捷運 Taichung MRT, KRTC 高雄捷運 Kaohsiung MRT.

name: metro_frequency
title: Metro train frequency
